overall: Violation found: the School Committee's minutes of the June 9, 2015 meeting, revised only by attaching the complainant's statement, failed to summarize the discussion. The AG found no intent and ordered amended minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee's post-complaint revisions to the June 2015 minutes were only cosmetic and did not summarize his prepared statement.
allegations.key_passage: Simply attaching the statement does not meet the Committee's obligation to summarize the discussion in its minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant asked that the minutes violation be found intentional because the committee had previously been advised about insufficient executive session minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Based on this good faith effort to make the information available, we find that this violation was not intentional.

allegations.summary: In a further-review request, complainant alleged the committee improperly published his personal notes, a claim not in the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: This allegation was not contained in the original complaint filed with the Committee.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within thirty days of receipt of the letter, amend the June 9, 2015 minutes to include a summary of the discussion that took place.
remedy_passage: we order the Committee, within thirty days of receipt of this letter, to amend the minutes of the June 9, 2015 meeting to include a summary of the discussion that took place.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
